body: A wound around boundaries and sensitivity: you feel everything, absorb what isn't yours, and can lose your own edges. When the ache gets to be too much, the pull is to escape or numb it rather than stay with it.
business: You become a compassionate presence for others in pain, having lived in it.
shadow: Slipping into fog, numbing, or martyrdom instead of gently tending the wound.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
